phase_mapping.LOAD: AwaitLoad: store LoadCurrent and bounded outer/Framework wire decode; no live publication
phase_mapping.VALIDATE: Precommit: Runtime Prepare and SaveGameOrchestrator Restore validation/migration
phase_mapping.STAGE: Precommit: Runtime prepared composition and all Framework participant stages privately owned
phase_mapping.COMMIT_SEMANTIC: CommittedSemantic: SaveGame no-throw participant commit followed by Runtime prepared-stage no-throw publication under the same restore lease
phase_mapping.REBUILD_TRANSIENT: RebuildTransient: injected composition rebuild, completed phase cursor retained
phase_mapping.RECONCILE_EXTERNAL: ReconcileExternal: injected accepted-work reconciliation; retry preserves accepted work identity
phase_mapping.MATERIALIZE_RUNTIME: MaterializeRuntime: injected projection rebuild; no simulation resume until completed
phase_mapping.RESUME: ReadyToResume: CanResume only after all three successful callbacks and release of the complete restore lease

precommit.fallible_preparation: Runtime Prepare validates and allocates an unpublished composition. SaveGame Restore validates, migrates and allocates every stage before its commit loop.
precommit.publication: Runtime stage Commit is noexcept; Framework participant CommitRestore is noexcept. No fallible callback is called between their publication boundaries.
precommit.failure_policy: Any precommit failure leaves both original live planes unchanged, disposes every private stage and releases quiescence; the same coordinator may retry LOAD.

remaining_qualification: 5.4.B: production Runtime restore-port implementation, fresh Base/Runtime/Framework whole-engine composition and real RuntimeBridge identity/causal continuation
5.4.C: whole-engine LOAD/VALIDATE/STAGE/postcommit failure matrix and fresh-process restore
